about_the_game:
Swing Through

Use your grappling hook to traverse levels. Build momentum and time it right to reach places hard to get to

Dodge Danger

Run and doge enemies as you explore your way out to reach to the next level

Strike Back

Aim and shoot your grappling hook at enemies and obstacles to progress through levels

Try Again Immediately

Reloads are instant. Try again from where you left without starting over. No long and boring death screens

Make Friends

Meet interesting characters along your way. Friends or foes, meet their personalities and their stories

Overcome Obstacles

Put your skills to test in handcrafted challenges on every level

Explore

Keep an eye open to find secrets. Paths and collectables may be hidden in every corner

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 and Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 windowing system; Other configuration and user environment as provided by default with the supported distribution (Kernel, Compositor, etc.); Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver or AMD Mesa graphics driver
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 windowing system; Other configuration and user environment as provided by default with the supported distribution (Kernel, Compositor, etc.); Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver or AMD Mesa graphics driver

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers

  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple officially supported drivers
